thesis_summary.thesis: NuScale Power develops small modular reactor (SMR) nuclear technology and licenses its NuScale Power Module design. **[Fact]** The company has **one** operating segment (10-K FY2025). **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$23.9 million**, up from **$4.2 million** in FY2024, primarily from related-party engineering services to Fluor (**76.0%** of revenue in 2025). **[Fact]** Operating loss was approximately **$690 million** and cash was **$836 million** at December 31, 2025 (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260226_rpt20251231_acc0001822966_26_000018.htm`). **[Fact]** Class A shares outstanding were approximately **318.5 million** at year-end. **[Fact]** The company is pre-revenue on reactor electricity sales; it earns licensing and engineering fees while pursuing deployment partnerships.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: The market may treat SMR as a proven nuclear utility rather than a pre-deployment licensor with concentrated customer risk. **[Inference]** Positive GAAP net income (**$356 million**) reflects warrant and derivative accounting, not sustainable owner cash. **[Inference]** ENTRA1's non-binding **72 NPM** agreement and Romania's Doicesti approval are milestones, not contracted reactor cash flows yet. **[Inference]** **$339 million** of contractual obligations due in 2026, including **$260 million** PMA milestone contribution, may require dilution if not funded by partners.
open_questions: [ ] Confirm ENTRA1 binding status and PMA funding plan
